items.statement: Among women referred in one year, completing four or more sessions is less common in women who report childcare barriers, live more than 20 kilometres away or need an interpreter, each with a prevalence ratio of 0.7 or lower.
items.rationale: The factors come from retrieved records (c1, c2, c4); linking reported and recorded factors for the same women is new and directly shapes the redesign.
items.risks: Low response among non-attenders; interpreter need recorded inconsistently.

items.statement: Women who would attend evening or online classes are over-represented among non-attenders.
items.rationale: Tests whether the timing change seen elsewhere (c3) would reach the women now missing.
